# Aluminium Designs - Gauteng Architectural Aluminium & Structural Steel

> Custom manufacturing, on-site laser measurement, and SANS 10400 certified installation of architectural aluminium doors, windows, frameless glass, security gates, burglar bars, and steel carports across Gauteng, South Africa.

## Business Details & Workshop HQ
- Company: Aluminium Designs

- Geographic Coordinates: -26.3458, 28.1633
- Phone / WhatsApp: 071 612 2439 (+27 71 612 2439)
- Email: info@aluminiumdesigns.co.za
- Website: https://www.aluminiumdesigns.co.za
- Operating Hours: Monday to Saturday: 08:00 – 18:00 (Sunday: Closed)
- Service Radius: 60km mobile workshop coverage across all 5 Gauteng municipalities
- Compliance: SANS 10400-N (Glazing Safety), SANS 10400-XA (Energy Efficiency), AAAMSA, Qualicoat Approved Powder Coating

## Primary Divisions & Products

### 1. Architectural Aluminium Windows & Doors
- Aluminium Windows (Top-Hung, Casement, Sliding, Side-Hung)
- Aluminium Sliding Doors (Patio 2-Panel, 3-Panel, 4-Panel Heavy-Duty)
- Aluminium Stacking Folding Doors (Multi-Leaf Frameless & Framed Vista-Fold)
- Aluminium Front Entrance Pivot & Hinged Doors
- French Double Doors
- Aluminium Garage Doors
- Double-Glazed Noise & Thermal Insulated Windows

### 2. Frameless Glass & Interior Systems
- Frameless Glass Balustrades
- Glass Patio Enclosures & Sunrooms
- Frameless Glass Shower Doors
- Custom Steam Rooms & Saunas
- Office Glass Partitions & Dividers
- Commercial Glass Shopfronts
- Architectural Glass Skylights

### 3. Structural Steel Works & High-Security Barriers
- Heavy-Duty Steel Security Gates (Single & Double Swing, Slamlock)
- Retractable Trellis Security Gates & Trellis Doors
- Solid Steel Window Burglar Bars
- Clear Polycarbonate Burglar Bars
- Automated Sliding Driveway Gates & Swing Gates
- Centurion Gate Motor Systems (D5 Smart, D10, D20)
- Steel Palisade Perimeter Fencing
- Clear View High-Security Mesh Fencing
- Residential & Commercial Steel Carports (IBR & Corrugated)
- Steel Balustrades & Fire Escape Staircases
- On-Site Mobile Welding & Structural Repairs

### 4. Specialized Maintenance & Glazing Repairs
- Aluminium Window Repairs (Friction stay hinges, handles, seals)
- Sliding Door Repairs (Heavy-duty brass & nylon rollers, stainless steel tracks, alignment)
- Emergency Glass Replacement (SANS 10400 laminated & toughened safety glass)
- Steel-to-Aluminium Frame Conversions
- Seamless Aluminium Gutters (Mobile on-site roll forming)

- West Rand: Krugersdorp, Randfontein, Roodepoort
- Sedibeng & Vaal: Vereeniging, Vanderbijlpark, Meyerton, Heidelberg
